Initialize a markermd grading project

Source: R/project.R
init_project.Rd

Bootstraps a markermd project in a directory laid out by ghclass::org_grade_assignment() (a repos/ directory of student repositories, a comments/ directory, an optional key/solution repository, and a directory per downloaded artifact). It creates a .markermd/ directory at the project root holding the SQLite grading database and a config.yml recording the project's file locations, and installs the bundled agent skills so they are discoverable from the project: the Claude Code set into <path>/.claude/skills/ and the Codex set into <path>/.agents/skills/ (see agents). It also writes each selected agent's project instructions file at the project root (CLAUDE.md for Claude Code, AGENTS.md for Codex) describing the project layout, the grading workflow and skills, and the rules an agent must follow when working with student submissions. An existing instructions file is kept, so it can be customized freely, unless overwrite_instructions = TRUE; pass instructions = FALSE to skip this step.

Usage

init_project(
  path,
  agents = c("claude", "codex"),
  instructions = TRUE,
  overwrite_instructions = FALSE,
  rescan_artifacts = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

Path to the project directory.

agents

Which agents' skill sets to install: "claude" (into <path>/.claude/skills/), "codex" (into <path>/.agents/skills/), or both, the default. The same selection decides which instructions files are written.

instructions

Whether to write the selected agents' project instructions files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) at the project root when they do not already exist. Defaults to TRUE.

overwrite_instructions

Whether to replace existing instructions files with the packaged versions, discarding any local edits to them (for example to pick up the instructions shipped with a newer markermd). Defaults to FALSE; has no effect when instructions = FALSE.

rescan_artifacts

Whether a re-run rebuilds the artifact directory list from every non-repository top-level directory instead of keeping the configured one. Defaults to FALSE; the first run always scans.

Value

A markermd_project object, invisibly.

Details

The key (solution) repository is detected as the top-level git repository (student repositories live under repos/); when several top-level repos exist, the one whose name contains "key" is used. When no top-level git repository exists (a copied or unpacked layout, such as the bundled example project), a directory whose name contains "key" and that holds an assignment document (.qmd/.Rmd) is used instead. On the first run the remaining top-level directories that are not git repositories are recorded as artifact directories.

Re-running init_project() on an already-initialized directory updates it in place: the existing grading database (including any stored grading template) is preserved, the skills are refreshed to the packaged version, existing instructions files are left untouched (unless overwrite_instructions = TRUE), and a previously configured key is kept (or cleared if it no longer exists). The configured artifact directories are kept too, minus any that no longer exist: top-level directories created since (working notes, backups) are listed but not added, so add one with project_set(artifacts = ), or pass rescan_artifacts = TRUE to rebuild the list from every non-repository top-level directory as on the first run.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ghclass::org_grade_assignment("hw01", org = "my-course", repo_filter = "hw01-")
init_project("hw01")
} # }
